- Updated Transaction Statistics to use the same expanded filters as list4.

- Existing performance and billing APIs are unchanged.

- Bumped version to 1.1.0.

- Updated configuration instructions for PARTNERBOOST_API_KEY to clarify that setup depends on the client used, not a specific file or format.
- Added README.md and README.zh-CN.md documentation files.

- No file changes detected in this release.
